description:
Overseeing the production checking to packing processes.
 identifying potential areas for improvement, Ensuring smooth delivery processes.
Perform the review & approval of SOP & other controlled procedure.
Identify and investigate quality issues, and recommend corrective actions.
Coordinate with buyers' QA & QC representatives during pre-final and final inspections.
Analyze product defects, identify root causes, and work with production teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
Responsible to ensure all quality control processes comply with industry standards and buyer specifications.
